changes: Paint negative table stacking layers before ordinary content
Separate auto-z wrapper drawing from positioned descendants
Reverse the same layers for pointer targeting; internal table tracks do not become direct pointer targets
Preserve complete table replay and suppress capture of split ancestor ranges

release.includes: Live negative/auto/zero/positive stacking mutations and unrelated-panel repaint compared with forced full rebuild

remaining: Subsequent numeric-opacity stacking correction must be qualified before installation
Assess partially transparent pixel differences and broader game UI requirements

timing_budget.policy: Every measured run must meet every p95 time limit; no averaging away failures.

definition.name: Frontier development desktop automatic 3D targets
definition.description: Provisional engineering targets chosen before measurement: 60 FPS whole-scene p95 at1080p, with existing UI API limits and corresponding cumulative core limits. Automatic updates include deferred core work. Whole-frame measurements include the scene and scheduling; these limits do not isolate UI cost or certify other hardware.
